scientific_claim: Under the exact frozen Branch36 ECS S3 Width Transfer regime, varying only raw microscopic width across N in {36,48,72}, S3=(mu,M,T3) transfers the Branch35 result as a privileged intervention-supported approximate local dynamical macrostate relative to S2 and RAND83: all A/B/C split gates passed independently at every width, all frozen final-width gates passed independently at every width, and all frozen final pooled gates passed.
theorem_context: For the frozen cubic primitive phi(z)=0.5 z + 0.5 z^2 + 0.5 z^3 with raw-sum forward map, S3 exactly determines the instantaneous forward function. This theorem about the current function does not imply exact dynamical Markov closure under microscopic training.
title: ECS S3 Width Transfer
